description: Local LLM inference on Xbox Series S in Developer Mode: llama.cpp (GGUF) + ONNX Runtime GenAI, an OpenAI-compatible LAN endpoint (off by default), SD-Turbo image generation and experimental on-device fine-tuning. Not yet tested on Series X. Independent project, not affiliated with Microsoft.
